connection_scope: one authenticated project and principal per connection

legacy_astrocyte.wire_compatibility: existing tool names, input and output shapes retained
legacy_astrocyte.report_event_retry: legacy random origin key; query original outcome instead of blind retry
legacy_astrocyte.human_experience_approval: not available to Agent MCP connections

event_receipt.meaning: SWA saved the source reference; no approval, remote consumption or execution is implied

capability_rule: A saved connection is configuration metadata. Probe and actual invocation are separate checks; no executable or account is inferred from configuration_ref.
